'''András P Huhn''' ([[Szeged]], 26 January 1947 – [[Szeged]], 6 June 1985) was a Hungarian mathematician. [[Huhn's theorem]] on the representation of [[Distributivity (order theory)|distributive]] [[semilattice]]s is named after him.
